description: Retrieves members of a Trello card, identified by its ID or shortLink, allowing customization of which member fields are returned.

fields.description: Comma-separated list of member fields to return (e.g., 'avatarHash,fullName,username'), or 'all' for all fields. Valid fields: avatarHash, bio, bioData, confirmed, fullName, idPremOrgsAdmin, initials, memberType, products, status, url, username.
fields.title: Fields

idCard.description: The ID or shortLink of the Trello card from which to retrieve members. Card IDs are typically 24-character hexadecimal strings.
idCard.title: Id Card

name: get_cards_members_by_id_card

members.description: Array of member objects associated with the card
members.title: Members

activityBlocked.description: Whether the member's activity is blocked
activityBlocked.title: Activity Blocked

avatarHash.description: Hash identifier for the member's avatar
avatarHash.title: Avatar Hash

avatarSource.description: Source of the avatar (e.g., upload, gravatar)
avatarSource.title: Avatar Source

avatarUrl.description: URL to the member's avatar image. Returns null if privacy settings are not public
avatarUrl.title: Avatar Url

bioData.description: Object containing additional bio data including emoji
bioData.title: Bio Data

confirmed.description: Whether the member account is confirmed
confirmed.title: Confirmed

email.description: The member's email address. Only accessible with 'account' scope in token
email.title: Email

fullName.description: The member's full display name. Returns username value if privacy settings are not public
fullName.title: Full Name

idBoards.description: Array of board IDs the member belongs to
idBoards.title: Id Boards

idEnterprise.description: ID of the enterprise the member belongs to
idEnterprise.title: Id Enterprise

idMemberReferrer.description: ID of the member who referred this member
idMemberReferrer.title: Id Member Referrer

idOrganizations.description: Array of organization IDs the member belongs to
idOrganizations.title: Id Organizations

idPremOrgsAdmin.description: Array of premium organization IDs where the member is an admin
idPremOrgsAdmin.title: Id Prem Orgs Admin

loginTypes.description: Array of login methods available for the member
loginTypes.title: Login Types

premiumFeatures.description: Array of premium features available to the member
premiumFeatures.title: Premium Features

products.description: Array of products/subscriptions the member has access to
products.title: Products

trophies.description: Array of trophies earned by the member
trophies.title: Trophies

url.description: URL to the member's Trello profile
url.title: Url
